mentions.name: Rejection Email Analyzer
mentions.description: A tool that analyzes the 1,600+ job rejection emails the author received during recent job searches and generates simple bar graphs from the data.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a simple joke tool to analyze all the rejection emails (over 1600) that I got during the recent job searches and create simple bar graphs from it. Wrote a blog about it https://github.com/khante/l here https://rohankhante.substack.com/p/thank-you-for-your-application-breakdown.
